notes.title: Tardy OSX version!
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone! 
https://i.imgur.com/FnfomXg.jpg
We glad to announce that Tardy will be released on OSX today! We are looking forward to new players in our game.
Also, Linux-version is coming soon! Keep in touch ;) 
Thank you all for your attention and your feedback!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Hello!

We fixed a couple more things:

Fixed minor text errors in the Russian version
Fixed the problem, due to which fonts were too small in some resolutions
Fixed a bug due to which some players can't see main menu
Fixed the problem with the loading of chapters

Thank you!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Hi!

We've read your feedback and made a few more changes.

List of changes:

Puzzle with the search for login / password has become more logical
Fixed puzzle with ventilation
Key objects in the dark room now glow
Fixed a bug at the end of the second chapter


Thank you for your feedback! With your help, the game gets better!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Patch 1.0.1

Hi, everyone!

We’ve read the first reviews and made a couple of edits that will make the game better.

Here is the list of changes:

 Fixed some localization mistakes
 Fixed bug with envelope
 Fixed a mini-game interface


Please, tell us about what you like and what prevents you from enjoying the game. This will help us to make the game better!

Thank you!
